title: Fix Incoming Documents default processed filter
summary: The Incoming Documents page now defaults to showing only unprocessed records when opened without a filter, while preserving explicit filter choices. This restores the expected behavior after a regression.
key_points: Opening the page without a filter again defaults to unprocessed documents (Processed = false)
An explicit Processed = true filter is no longer cleared, and explicit true or false filters are kept
Regression tests cover the unfiltered, true and false filter scenarios
Show All and Show Unprocessed actions keep their existing behavior
